primary: Fixed shell source versus unit Gaussian and analytically covariance-matched harmonic tree under identical geometry-only self-conditioning.
pilot_gate: Shell graph count exceeds BOTH controls in EACH training seed; pooled conditional paired95 lower bound positive against BOTH; pooled distinct-connectivity rate no more than2pp below either control.
failure_rule: No parameter, source-width, LR, sampler or seed selection based on this reused12-condition development panel.
data_scope: Same audited TRAIN coordinate rows and composition exclusions; no scaffold or evaluation geometry used for fitting.
compute: All arms3000 updates with two differentiable denoiser passes;32 midpoint steps and128 primitive denoiser calls per generated sample. Shell training/evaluation reused with full hashes, not counted as new draws.
source_control: Harmonic tree has the same latent-tree law and analytically identical conditional covariance as shell source; its Gaussian edge kernel removes the radial shell. This is the essential moment control; a separate approximate covariance Gaussian is omitted.
claim_boundary: Development experiment only; fixed probabilistic source may be the contribution but no originality, held-out-composition, Boltzmann-law or ICLR-readiness claim follows automatically.
